system.description:
The mage invests raw Prime energy into another sphere’s effect, letting magick create lasting or ‘real’ things rather than mere illusions, and fortify conjured patterns against unraveling. Rank 3 channels Quintessence into effects and can empower objects. It is the connective tissue that makes other spheres’ creations endure.

Dice Pool: Intelligence + Occult (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Prime 3; mechanics paraphrased.
